C_PIN_ATTACH_TOOLTIP: Declares a pin constant. The device kind only changes the block label, never the code. The last slot is the form: constant -> const int LED = 13;  macro -> #define LED 13  variable -> int LED = 13; All three are equivalent on Arduino, and the block remembers the one you wrote, so it will not rewrite it for you. Going from code to blocks, the device is guessed from the variable name; when it cannot be guessed it shows as "part".
